vertical_model.status: North roof held at its normalized-height median; south addition uses a reproducible low-slope plane fitted to 2018 NDHM spatial-bin medians. Both are representative roof-surface estimates, not surveyed eaves.

facade: Neutral envelope remains otherwise unverified. Nine emergency-exit locations from Purdue's dated AHF egress plan are represented by schematic door panels; the plan does not identify the public/main entrance, door materials, windows, or facade composition.
roof: The 2023 orthophoto identifies light north/main and darker south roof zones. A 2018 NDHM fit across four spatial bin sizes shows no stable north/main slope, so it remains at its 4.036 m median; the south zone has a stable approximately -4.0% Y trend and is modeled as a low-slope plane. This is a normalized surface trend, not a surveyed roof profile; eaves and framing remain unresolved.

height_and_facade_uncertainty.status: North/main roof is held at its 2018 NDHM median; south addition uses the robust Y trend from 2018 NDHM spatial-bin medians. These are representative normalized roof surfaces, not surveyed eaves.

ndhm_roof_profile.north_main: 614 samples; regression slopes range -0.029% to -0.831% Y over 2.5–10 m bins, with marginal or inconsistent residual improvement; retained flat at median 4.036 m.
ndhm_roof_profile.south_addition: 359 samples; Y slope ranges -4.022% to -4.752% across 2.5–10 m bins. At 5 m bins, plane median absolute residual is 0.060 m versus 0.381 m for a flat median surface. Modeled XY slopes are -1.484% X and -4.159% Y.
ndhm_roof_profile.limitation: Surface trend is not an eave survey; local ground normalization, rooftop objects, grid resolution, and zone-boundary uncertainty may contribute.

height_and_facade_uncertainty.roof: 2018 NDHM supports median normalized heights of 4.036 m north/main and 5.166 m south addition; 2023 orthophoto supports their plan-zone split. The south addition's stable broad Y trend is modeled, while structural eaves, framing, and exact seam remain unresolved.
height_and_facade_uncertainty.facade: Nine emergency-exit locations are source-backed by the dated AHF-01 plan and shown as schematic door panels. Public/main entrance identity, facade materials, windows, and elevations remain unverified.

emergency_exits.registration: Compass arrow indicates north to the right of the page. The plan outline was approximately fitted to the official Purdue GIS footprint bounding box; red exit arrows were mapped to local XY and snapped to the nearest exterior GIS edge.
emergency_exits.uncertainty: The plan is not georeferenced or dimensioned; pixel-to-footprint registration is approximate. Red arrows identify emergency exits, not necessarily the public/main entrance. Door sizes and exterior appearance are schematic estimates.

geometry_edits: Replaced prior 16 m box with the 16-node Purdue GIS footprint.
Extruded one diagrammatic level to 4.4 m plus 0.4 m cap; vertical dimensions are estimates.
Preserved manifest stable ID, scene, collection, object name, and campus coordinate frame.

Split the roof surface into two georeferenced material zones matching the light north/main roof and darker south roof visible in 2023 Indiana imagery; no unsupported roof elevations or facade details were added.
Added perimeter faces to both roof slabs so the exported roof volumes are closed; reopened in Blender 4.5.15 and verified zero boundary or non-manifold edges.

Split the roof surface into two georeferenced zones matching the 2023 orthophoto; held the north at its 2018 NDHM median and fit a low-slope south plane to 2018 NDHM spatial-bin medians (four bin sizes reproduce a -4.0% to -4.8% Y trend); no facade detail was inferred.

Added nine schematic emergency-exit door panels at plan-derived positions from Purdue's AHF-01 emergency-exits drawing; positions are snapped to the GIS shell, while dimensions and appearance remain estimates.
